_note: School campus layout - SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the walkable world (PROJECT.md section 7). Minimal placeholder campus: TWO buildings forming an L that opens to the SOUTHEAST: a WEST building (running north-south, doors face east) and a NORTH building (running east-west, doors face south). They are NOT connected (a gap between them). Each building is TWO STORIES: a ground floor and a second floor, each with 4 classrooms (4 doors per floor per building = 16 stamp rooms total; the 4 special rooms ELD/Music/Learning/Theater are added at Milestone 7). A rectangular grass FIELD sits in the middle; the area INSIDE the L is PAVEMENT; everything OUTSIDE is ASPHALT. A parking lot with cars sits far WEST, behind the west building. There are NO outer perimeter walls - only the two buildings (ground story) and the second-story walls (up top) are solid; everything else is walkable. Each building has an EXTERIOR staircase on its back side (west building: SOUTH side; north building: EAST side) that climbs from the ground to the second floor. On the second floor a WALKWAY runs from the stair landing along the field-facing wall to the 4 upstairs doors. (Prototype: second floor = a walkable platform with second-story walls, door frames, and a marked walkway; real furnished interiors arrive at Milestone 7.) The 2D map (Milestone 9) and classroom doors (Milestone 7) are generated from THIS file. Coordinates: x = east(+)/west(-), z = south(+)/north(-), y = up (north is -z). walls are the solid ground-story building blocks (center x,z + size w,d) used for BOTH rendering and collision - keep them axis-aligned. Doors line up with classrooms.json by id and sit on the field-facing wall of each room; floor 0 = ground (y~1.5), floor 1 = second floor (y~7.8); axis is the direction the door opening runs along (z = opening runs north-south on an east/west-facing wall, x = opening runs east-west on a north/south-facing wall). Stairs: width = cross-sectional width (perpendicular to the climb), len = climb length along the climb axis, axis = climb direction (z = north-south, x = east-west), dir = +1/-1 step direction along the axis, bottom/top = climb-axis coordinate at the ground (bottom) and second floor (top). cars are decorative parked cars (no collision). boundary and gate are METADATA ONLY (not rendered): the gate returns at Milestone 11 (arrival animation). Real room numbers/names arrive at Milestone 16.
